articles.title: Crypto trading giant GSR's new vault business is a $100M bet on onchain credit
articles.snippet: The firm is putting its own capital into stablecoin and tokenized gold vaults as institutional finance moves further onchain.

articles.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
articles.snippet: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.

articles.title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
articles.snippet: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

articles.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
articles.snippet: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $82.7K October low as bond sell-off resumes on Iran nerves
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to reach month-to-date lows as stocks reversed after all-time highs and bond yields spiked higher.
